newsitem.title: UK: Macfarlane Group sees lower pretax profits.
newsitem.headline: Macfarlane Group sees lower pretax profits.

text.p: UK packaging company Macfarlane Group Plc said on Tuesday it expected its pretax profit for the year to be modestly below that of the previous year.
The company previously predicted that its results for the current year would be ahead of last year.
Macfarlane had pretax profits of 21.2 million stg last year.
The company's shares fell 25p to 172.5p at 0815.

"Mainly as a result of destocking in the spirits industry which affected the plastic moulding division, we now expect the group pre-tax profit for the year to be modestly below that of the previous year," the company said in a statement.
The company added that its packaging division continued to trade in line with its expectations.
